lesson.title: Installing Jenkins Plug-ins
lesson.summary: Understand installing jenkins plug ins from first principles, with a small runnable example.

stage.description: Packaging and deploying PHP applications, plus modern CI/CD delivery panels.

payload.markdown: Jenkins is highly customizable, and I will need quite a few plug-ins to integrate with the features I have described so far in this chapter. From within the Jenkins web interface, I click Manage Jenkins and then Manage Plugins. Beneath the Available tab, I find a long list. I select the checkboxes in the Install column for all plug-ins that I wish to add to Jenkins. Table 21-1 describes the plug-ins that I will be using.
